basic_details.short_information: This recruitment fills vacant High Technical Instructor cum Advisor posts in various sports academies of the Madhya Pradesh Sports and Youth Welfare Department. Vacancies are listed academy by academy, in grades A to E. The official notification does not specify the age limit, the application fee or the selection process.

qualification.education_qualification: Grade-wise sports achievement or coaching experience, by discipline
qualification.details: The notice sets eligibility by grade, not by degree. Each grade has its own sports achievement or coaching experience, and these apply "by discipline" (विधा अनुसार). The notice names no educational degree for the posts. | Grade A: participated in the Olympics / World Cup (4-yearly) / medal winner in the Asian Games; or a player honoured with the Padma Shri / Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna / Arjuna Award; or a coach honoured with the Dronacharya Award; or a coach who trained an Indian team that took part in the Olympics; or the actual coach of an Indian team/player who won a medal in the World Cup (4-yearly) / Asian Games / Commonwealth Games; or a judge/referee (निर्णायक) in the said competition of own sport. Grade B: a medal-winning player in the relevant discipline in the Commonwealth Games / Afro-Asian Games; or the actual coach of the Indian team/player in these games; or a judge/referee in the said competition of own sport. Grade C: a medal-winning player in the relevant discipline of a recognised Asian Championship / South Asian Games, or a coach of an Indian team/player who won a medal in these games; or a player or coach of an Indian team that won medals in international championships/competitions of the sport recognised by the Government of India in three separate years; or a judge/referee in the said competition of own sport. Grade D: a player who won a medal in a recognised international championship; or NIS-trained with at least 6 months' experience of training an Indian team as coach; or a coach who holds a coaching certificate from the relevant sports federation. Grade E: coaches recommended by Grade A, B and C technical-expert-cum-coaches, who have trained a national team or renowned academies or institutions. The work of these coaches is evaluated and recommended by the chief technical expert of Grade A, B or C. | The notice says the qualification, experience and eligibility details, and the rate of remuneration, are available on www.dsywmp.gov.in. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many High Technical Instructor cum Advisor vacancies has DSYWMP announced?
faq.answer: The notice lists 53 posts in 21 sports academies: Grade A 13, Grade B 8, Grade C 19 and Grade D/E 13.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for DSYWMP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 18 November 2026 (Wednesday), office hours up to 6:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for the DSYWMP High Technical Instructor cum Advisor posts?
faq.answer: Submit the application at the Directorate of Sports and Youth Welfare, T.T. Nagar Stadium, Bhopal. It may also be sent by e-mail to [email protected].

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for the DSYWMP High Technical Instructor cum Advisor posts?
faq.answer: The monthly rate is Rs. 2,25,000 (Grade A), Rs. 1,55,000 (B), Rs. 1,15,000 (C), Rs. 77,500 (D) and Rs. 50,000 (E).

faq.question: Q5. Does the pay include allowances?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice prints the rate as including accommodation, food and local conveyance allowance.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification for Grade A?
faq.answer: Grade A needs Olympic or World Cup (4-yearly) participation or an Asian Games medal, or a Padma Shri, Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna, Arjuna or Dronacharya honour, or the coaching or judging record listed under Grade A above.

faq.question: Q7. Is a CV alone enough to apply?
faq.answer: No. The notice says an application with only a CV will not be accepted; educational qualification, experience and other documents and certificates must be attached.

faq.question: Q8. Can I send the application by e-mail as well as offline?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice says applicants can send the application offline and also by e-mail to [email protected].

faq.question: Q9. Where will the posts be located?
faq.answer: The academies are at Jabalpur (Archery), Gwalior (Badminton), Shivpuri (Women Cricket) and Bhopal (all other listed academies).

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the detailed eligibility and remuneration rates?
faq.answer: The notice says these are available on the Madhya Pradesh Sports and Youth Welfare Department website, www.dsywmp.gov.in.
